title: Company Overview - London-listed Luxury Real Estate Developer
summarized_data: Dar Global is a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor, and asset manager creating high-quality communities, landmark destinations, and lifestyle-driven assets across premier global markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and London. The company spans premium hospitality, commercial, entertainment, and exclusive golf communities, owning, investing, developing, and operating high-end real estate for long-term value.
